premises: Nanoclustering of Cr, Ni, and Mn at grain boundaries reduces cohesion in CrMnFeCoNi
Ductility loss in CrMnFeCoNi is correlated with intergranular cracking due to this nanosegregation
Redirecting segregating elements into preexisting Cr-rich secondary phases can avoid ductility loss
Minor dopant addition and tailored thermal treatment can promote such benign secondary phases
